title: Digital Nudge Effects in Optimal Stopping Games: Antagonistic Interactions in Layered Choice Architectures
abstract: arXiv:2610.28154v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Digital nudges have become a prominent area of research in human-centered interaction, yet little is known about how they interact when deployed together. This study examines the individual and combined effects of anchoring, salience, and social proof digital nudges on stopping behavior and outcome quality in a sequential decision task. Using a 2^3 between-subjects factorial design grounded in the secretary problem (N = 181), we find that (1) an anchor nudge significantly increased exploration rather than constraining it (b = 1.207, p = .017); (2) the salience nudge produced the smallest effect of any condition; and (3) combining the anchor and social proof nudges produced the worst outcome quality of any condition ($181.83 vs. $192.21 for anchor-only), with outcome quality declining monotonically as nudge count increased. translated_title: 最优停止博弈中的数字助推效应：分层选择架构中的对抗性交互作用
translated_abstract: 数字助推已成为以人为中心的交互研究中的一个重要领域，然而对于多种数字助推同时部署时如何相互作用，目前知之甚少。本研究在一个序贯决策任务中考察了锚定、显著性（凸显性）和社会认同（社会证明）三种数字助推对停止行为及结果质量的单独效应与组合效应。研究基于秘书问题，采用2³被试间因子设计（N = 181），结果发现：(1) 锚定助推显著增加了探索行为而非限制探索（b = 1.207，p = .017）；(2) 显著性助推在所有条件中产生了最小的效应；(3) 锚定助推与社会认同助推的组合产生了所有条件中最差的结果质量（181.83美元 vs. 仅锚定条件下的192.21美元），且结果质量随助推数量的增加而单调下降。这些发现为数字助推的挤出效应提供了首个受控实验证据，并具有直接的实践启示。
tldr: 该研究基于秘书问题的2³因子实验首次提供了受控证据，表明多种数字助推（锚定、显著性、社会认同）组合使用时会产生对抗性交互，结果质量随助推数量增加而单调下降，揭示了数字助推的“挤出效应”。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first controlled evidence of a digital nudge crowding-out effect, showing that combined digital nudges (anchoring, salience, and social proof) interact antagonistically in a secretary-problem task, with outcome quality declining monotonically as the number of nudges increases.
